verdict.rationale: Grok Build has automation primitives: recurring `/loop` prompts, background monitors, hooks, skills, and headless scripting. It also offers review and rollback for agent work. Sessions are saved to disk with tool calls and file snapshots, you can restore files to any earlier point, plan mode drafts a plan for approval before edits, and transcripts export as Markdown. However, nothing shows that the automation definitions themselves (loops, hooks, skills) are versioned, diffed, reviewed, or rolled back as first-class objects. Missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, rollback of automation configs (as opposed to session file state), and independent corroboration.
